title: trailboss --json task definition
description: The version of its agent definition a task was planned with at `task add` and the one its folder would start now, one row: changed or unchanged; with --accept, would accept, accepted, or unchanged. Without --yes nothing changes. Only a queued task takes a new version: one whose definition changed waits until it's accepted, then starts at a look as before. Frontends should show an action they don't know as is.

action.description: changed, unchanged, would accept or accepted; more may be added.

detail.description: The definition's name, the version planned with and the one now, each as its source, file and the hash's first 12 characters.

path.description: Its file; null for a built-in one.

sha256.description: The SHA-256 of its content: the file's bytes, or a built-in's canonical JSON.

planned.description: The version it was planned with; null for a task added before Trailboss kept it.

path.description: Its file; null for a built-in one.

sha256.description: The SHA-256 of its content: the file's bytes, or a built-in's canonical JSON.

current.description: The version its folder would start now (accepted: the one recorded); null when there's no such definition.
